title: SB 2204 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to voter eligibility.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.

(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1, 2-2-401(c) (new)
(quote) The portal may also access data from the systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program from the United States department of homeland security, United States citizenship and immigration services (DHS-USCIS), if DHS-USCIS makes such data available via a secure web service.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1 also redesignates the existing 2-2-401(c) and later subsections of the section created by Public Chapter 473 (SB0133/HB0069).
(other) Sec. 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 3346243-Draft: slot d only (adds SAVE data to the 2-2-401 portal).
(other) version: 3426173-Chaptered (PC 775, HB2185): same text; no change.
(other) note: Builds on PC 473 (2-2-401). The portal is optional on the SAVE side ('may also access ... if DHS-USCIS makes such data available'). No document is required from an applicant. Only one roll call (Senate committee) is on SB2204; the floor action ran on HB2185.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.

votes.motion: Senate State & Local Government Committee, recommended for passage [version voted: Draft 3346243 as filed (no amendment recorded; same text as the chaptered law)]
